triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: npm run test:brief-output passes from inside a story worktree (doctor brief under 20000 bytes with no global-core-realpath warn block), while a genuine global-CLI mismatch fixture still produces the warn
acceptanceBindings.note: Green = worktree run passes budget with no warn; adversarial keeps genuine mismatch warning; red evidence RED-001 binds the failing npm run test:brief-output baseline.

note: Single acceptance claim; no milestone ledger (1-item checklist).
